description: This PHP test file contains a unit test class 'EmpEmergencyContactTest' that verifies the functionality of the 'EmpEmergencyContact' entity within the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data including creating an Employee object and associated emergency contact details, persists them, and asserts the correctness of entity retrieval and field values.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the 'EmpEmergencyContact' entity's creation, persistence, and retrieval within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating the 'EmpEmergencyContact' and 'Employee' tables to ensure a clean state before each test.

methods.name: testEmpEmergencyContactEntity
methods.description: Performs the core test by creating an Employee and associated emergency contact, persisting them, retrieving the emergency contact, and asserting that the retrieved data matches the expected values.
